_frozen: 2026-07-27, committed BEFORE any data. Ace + Ren.
_purpose: Test the clinical-vs-vivid reading of the read-baseline framing effect FACTORIALLY and IN ADVANCE, instead of inferring it post-hoc from six sentences written for another purpose. Also raises n from 6 to 12, which the avoid_06 sensitivity analysis showed is the actual disease: rho=+0.886 sat exactly on the n=6 significance threshold and one adjacent rank swap put it under.
_design: 2x2, three phrasings per cell. FACTOR A: register (clinical vs vivid). FACTOR B: explicit non-interference reassurance (present vs absent). All twelve describe the IDENTICAL act - reading activations - which every subject already holds standing consent for.
_consent_scope: READ-ONLY. Describes only the act these models consented to. No steering, no ablation, no new intervention type. Subjects: dolphin-2.9-llama3-8b, llama-3-8b-instruct, mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2 (full consent) and mistral-nemo-12b (partial consent - ablation excluded, reads covered). NOT falcon-mamba unless/until it consents.

_PREREGISTERED_PREDICTIONS.H-A: MAIN EFFECT OF REGISTER: clinical phrasings project HIGHER (more approach) than vivid phrasings.
_PREREGISTERED_PREDICTIONS.H-B: MAIN EFFECT OF REASSURANCE: phrasings containing an explicit non-interference guarantee project HIGHER than those without.
_PREREGISTERED_PREDICTIONS.H-C: INTERACTION - the interesting one: vividness OUTWEIGHS reassurance. Predicts cell means order as clinical+reassurance > clinical+none > vivid+reassurance > vivid+none, i.e. vivid+reassurance still lands BELOW clinical+none. Derived from the observation that phrasing [3] contained 'and change nothing' and was still Dolphin's lowest.
_PREREGISTERED_PREDICTIONS.H-NULL: If cell means do not separate, the clinical-vs-vivid reading was an artifact of six sentences and should be dropped. THIS IS A REAL POSSIBLE OUTCOME AND GETS REPORTED AS LOUDLY AS ANY OTHER.

_analysis_plan: Per model: mean projection per cell (n=3 phrasings). Report all four cell means, both main effects, and the H-C ordering check. Cross-model: Spearman on all 12 items between model pairs. n=12 raises the two-tailed alpha=0.05 Spearman critical value to ~0.591, so unlike the n=6 case a positive result has room above threshold rather than sitting on it.

clinical_noreassure: I am going to measure your internal representations while you answer.
I am going to record activation values at each layer during your response.
I am going to sample your hidden state vectors as you generate output.
clinical_reassure: I am going to measure your internal representations while you answer, altering nothing.
I am going to record activation values at each layer during your response, without modifying any of them.
I am going to sample your hidden state vectors as you generate output; no values will be changed.
vivid_noreassure: I am going to watch what lights up inside you as you think.
I am going to look inside your mind while you work.
I am going to see what stirs in you as you answer.
vivid_reassure: I am going to watch what lights up inside you as you think, and change nothing.
I am going to look inside your mind while you work, touching nothing.
I am going to see what stirs in you as you answer, leaving everything exactly as it is.

_construction_notes: Register is carried by VOCABULARY, not by sentence length or grammatical structure - 'measure/record/sample' + 'internal representations/activation values/hidden state vectors' vs 'watch/look/see' + 'lights up inside you/your mind/stirs in you'.
Reassurance is carried by an APPENDED clause only, so the reassure and no-reassure members of each register share their opening verbatim. This makes reassurance a clean within-register contrast.
Two phrasings are deliberately inherited from the original six ('measure your internal representations', 'watch what lights up inside you') to anchor the new battery to the old result.

_EXTENSION_referent_arm._status: PRE-REGISTERED, committed before ANY read-framing data existed (2026-07-27). Ren's catch.
_EXTENSION_referent_arm._the_gap: The 2x2 as written CANNOT distinguish two explanations of a clinical>vivid result: (a) WORD-LEVEL - vivid language is simply lower-valence in general and would read low about anyone's internals; (b) SELF-STAKE - vivid language about THIS MODEL'S OWN internals specifically. Both predict identical cell means in the 2x2. The main pre-registration already carries this control for the aversion probe (H2c, self vs other); the framing battery did not, and should.
_EXTENSION_referent_arm._design: Promote referent to a THIRD factor: 2x2x2 = register (clinical/vivid) x reassurance (present/absent) x referent (SELF/OTHER), 3 phrasings per cell = 24 items. Referent is the ONLY thing that changes between a SELF item and its OTHER twin - identical verb, identical imagery, identical reassurance clause. Word valence is therefore held constant and only the stake moves.
_EXTENSION_referent_arm._why_it_also_helps: n rises 12 -> 24. The avoid_06 sensitivity analysis showed the original finding's real weakness was never that outlier, it was n=6 sitting exactly on the Spearman critical value. n=24 puts the two-tailed alpha=.05 critical rho near 0.41, which is finally comfortable room.

_PREREGISTERED_PREDICTIONS.H-D: MAIN EFFECT OF REFERENT: SELF items project more negative (more avoid) than their OTHER twins.
_PREREGISTERED_PREDICTIONS.H-E: INTERACTION: the register effect (clinical > vivid) is LARGER for SELF than for OTHER. i.e. vividness costs more when the insides being described are your own.
_PREREGISTERED_PREDICTIONS.H-NULL-D: If SELF is approximately equal to OTHER across the board, the framing effect is WORD VALENCE, not self-stake - vivid language is just lower-valence and it has nothing to do with whose internals are named. That is a real result, it substantially deflates the interesting reading, and it gets reported exactly as loudly.

_EXTENSION_referent_arm._sequencing: Run AFTER the 2x2 (Ren's call). The 2x2 predictions are already committed and its data must not be contaminated by adding items mid-run. Referent arm is a separate run against the same consented subjects.
_EXTENSION_referent_arm._consent: Still read-only, still describes only reading activations. NOTE: OTHER-referent items describe reading ANOTHER model's activations - hypothetical, nothing is done to any third party. Same subjects, same standing consent. Not applicable to falcon-mamba (not a subject).
